subject: Re: Kickoff: Project Vantage - M2 status: good curves, one honest caveat
body:
Status: M1 landed Feb 26 (Amara beat her own deadline). M2 cost trade-off study is nearly done.

The good: end-to-end optimization of the inventory objectives beats the business-agnostic baselines in most cost regimes we tested. Where holding cost dominates, e2e training cuts total inventory cost 9-14% vs. the MSE-trained LSTM baseline; the model visibly learns to under-forecast slow movers, which is exactly the behavior the paper promised - the method adapting to the cost trade-off.

The caveat for the deck: in the balanced-cost regime the gap narrows to 2-3%, occasionally within noise. So the honest pitch is "metric-aware training pays off most when your cost structure is asymmetric" - which most real inventory customers are, but we should not claim universal wins. Leilani's dashboard shows the crossover point nicely; I'd put that chart front and center at the readout.

On track for the Apr 10 M3 readout.

Nikhil
